verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents official Simba JDBC/ODBC drivers explicitly built to 'connect your applications to BigQuery, letting you use BigQuery features with your preferred tooling and infrastructure,' directly addressing the analyst's need to plug dashboards in without custom glue. Missing for 10: explicit named BI-tool integration guides (e.g., Tableau/Looker/Power BI certified connectors) and independent/hands-on confirmation from analysts that dashboard connections work smoothly without extra glue.
